body:
The Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) Annual Energy Symposium (AES) is an event that features a case study competition and technical discussions.



Case study competition

SPE Java Section hosts an AES case study competition that focuses on a theme related to energy demand and carbon footprint. The competition includes a presentation and question-and-answer session for each team.



Technical discussions

SPE Java Section also hosts technical discussions that feature presentations from industry professionals. These discussions are free to attend and open to all SPE members and non-members.
